data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Atikah' which means pure, chaste, noble. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl. The name Atikahaat carries the meaning “Pure, Chaste, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Atikahaat usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, chaste, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Atikahaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Chaste, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Atikahaat total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
